free_tier.stated: Per the vendor's own plans API (api.cloud.onidel.com/instance_plans, USD, Sydney): ONI-1 at USD 4.95/month billed monthly, USD 3.96/month billed annually (USD 47.52 a year), USD 3.71/month biennially, USD 3.46/month triennially, USD 0.0074 hourly: 1 vCPU, 2 GB RAM, 20 GB NVMe, 1 TB data in the apac region (2 TB in na, 3 TB in eu) on a 1 Gbps port. Locations: Sydney, Melbourne, Singapore, Ho Chi Minh City, Amsterdam, New York. Stock: not published; the plans API exposes no stock field and the deploy flow at cloud.onidel.com requires an account. Renewal: not published; the plans API prints no renewal price.

egress.terms: monthly allocation covering inbound and outbound, poolable per region; overage at USD 3/TB, quoted from the vendor FAQ
egress.free_allowance: 1 TB a month on the entry plan in apac; 2 TB in na and 3 TB in eu, per the plans API's data_by_region

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
tooling: documented REST API at developers.onidel.com and a control panel at cloud.onidel.com; snapshots and scheduled backups (the 2 most recent retained, downloadable), custom ISO, noVNC console, cloud firewall, BGP session and floating IP; backup storage billed at USD 0.1/GB/month
chaining: USD 4.95 a month, USD 3.96 on the annual term (USD 47.52 a year), for 2 GB of RAM and 20 GB of NVMe with 1 TB of transfer in Melbourne is the cheapest Australian presence at this price, and the documented API plus snapshot and backup path make it deployable as a worker without a wrapper. The 1 TB inbound-and-outbound cap keeps it off a serving path.

limits.value: 1 TB a month on the entry plan in the apac region (2 TB in na, 3 TB in eu), per the vendor's plans API. The vendor FAQ states the allocation covers both inbound and outbound traffic, can be pooled across VMs in one region, and that overage costs USD 3/TB; inbound counting against the allowance halves the usable crawl volume.
